# `set_project_constraint`

**Set Project Constraint.** Set a scheduling constraint on a project.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `set_project_constraint` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | none |
| Retry safe | no |
| Timeout | none |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | `string` | yes | — | Project ID |
| `exclusive` | `boolean` | no | — | If true, only one agent may work on the project at a time (overrides max_concurrent_agents to 1). |
| `max_agents_by_type` | `object` | no | — | Per-agent-type concurrency limits, e.g. {"claude": 2, "codex": 1}. Agent types not listed are unrestricted. |
| `pause_scheduling` | `boolean` | no | — | If true, the scheduler skips this project entirely — no new tasks are assigned until the constraint is released. |
| `created_by` | `string` | no | — | Identifier of who/what set the constraint (e.g. workflow ID, admin name). Informational only. |
